title: Scaling Behavior of Parameterized Quantum Circuits from a Lie-Algebraic Perspective
summary: Understanding how the performance of parameterized quantum circuits scales with available resources is important for characterizing their trainability and effective model capacity. In this study, we numerically investigate data scaling, model scaling, and compute scaling in parameterized quantum circuits and examine Lie-algebraic quantities as alternative measures of model size.
